Sputum GeneXpert reveals Mycobacterium tuberculosis with rifampicin resistance. He is not yet started on ART. His CD4 count is 110 cells/mm³. What is the most appropriate management? (Q-30639477) (IRIS)
o: Start BPaLM regimen for 6 months and follow up for immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome
Start HEZ plus levofloxacin for 9 months and monitor for optic neuritis
Start HEZ plus linezolid for 9 months and monitor for hepatotoxicity
Start kanamycin-based MDR regimen for 20 months and continue ART without interruption
cb3366.ex: In HIV patients with rifampicin-resistant (RR/MDR) tuberculosis, the recommended management is an all-oral, shorter regimen such as BPaLM (Bedaquiline + Pretomanid + Linezolid + Moxifloxacin) for \~6 months. * GeneXpert showing rifampicin resistance = treat as MDR-TB * BPaLM regimen is now preferred: o Shorter duration (≈6 months) o Fully oral (no injectables) o Higher success rates HIV considerations: * Start ATT immediately * Initiate ART early (within 2 weeks for CD4 <200) * Monitor for IRIS after ART initiation Why not other options: * HEZ regimens → ineffective in rifampicin-resistant TB

cb5185.q: Researchers conduct a randomized controlled trial to evaluate the effect of a new exercise program versus standard lifestyle advice on lowering systolic blood pressure (SBP) in adults with prehypertension. A total of 200 participants are randomized equally between the two groups. After 6 months, the mean decrease in SBP is –6 mm Hg greater in the exercise group compared to the control group. The analysis yields a p-value of 0.02 (predetermined significance level = 0.05). Which of the following is the most accurate interpretation of this result? (Q-55667852) decrease in SBP
o: The probability that the null hypothesis (no difference in SBP) is true is 2%
The probability of obtaining these results by chance if the null hypothesis is true is 2%
There is a 2% chance that any individual in the exercise group will experience at least a 6 mm Hg
There is a 2% chance that the mean SBP reduction is biased in favor of the exercise group
cb5185.ex: A **p-value of 0.02** means: **Assuming the null hypothesis is true (no real difference in SBP), there is a 2% probability of observing a result as extreme as—or more extreme than—the one obtained purely due to random chance.** Since **p = 0.02 < α = 0.05**, the result is **statistically significant**, and the null hypothesis is rejected.
